entries.criterion: repository contains the exact Human Owner-accepted Contract bytes and attributable acceptance evidence.
canonical path, Contract SHA-256, source protected-main commit/tree and predecessor Snapshot identities are synchronized without mutation.
canonical state advances to SLICE-V1-003 Full-Scope Implementation only after exact acceptance and preserves every SLICE-V1-002 accepted identity.
roadmap preserves the Advertising & Traffic Efficiency outcome and records `AD_BID_CHANGE` as the selected controlled-write family.
SLICE-V1-002 `STOCK_CHANGE`, replenishment quantity, Overstock, Allocation and Transfer remain unopened.
Shared Spine architecture tests prevent a parallel ingestion, Metric, Policy, workflow, Command, Readback, Bundle or audit authority.
conditional Design Gate remains untriggered or any later trigger follows the exact governance path.
no Release, Gate EV, Gate E, Pilot, deployment or production-write authority is claimed by source completion, tests, merge or this Contract.
every atomic Case binds Organization, Platform, Account/Store, minimum verified controllable native object, lineage, bidding mode and Semantic Profile.
every atomic Case binds the exact complete affected Internal Variant set and a stable digest/version.
a native object controlling multiple Variants cannot be split into separately executable estimated-SKU Cases.
Campaign, ad-group, Target, Keyword and SKU relationships remain queryable without inventing unsupported Provider control granularity.
Ozon and Wildberries Profiles preserve their different object, status, attribution, unit, precision, step, quota and Readback semantics.
unknown native states/fields/modes fail closed for every dependent decision.
a native object, lineage or bidding-mode change invalidates stale executable assets unless exact versioned continuity is proven.
backend scope enforcement prevents horizontal and vertical Organization/Platform/Store/Product/Data/Action escalation.
the Maker can identify the exact controlled object and complete affected-set without automatically receiving unauthorized cross-Store or finance detail.
Operations Lead and final approver cannot endorse/approve without the evidence scope required by their responsibility.
permission masking is distinguishable from an actual data gap, and Task/Approval participation grants no implicit access.
API, export, notification, attachment, error and AI views enforce the same role/scope disclosure contract.
official advertising configuration, Spend and traffic facts retain Raw provenance, source times, correction history and Profile identity.
missing platform metrics remain `NOT_AVAILABLE`, never zero.
late/corrected official Spend triggers attributable recalculation without overwriting history.
Provider-native attributed Orders/Revenue/Conversion remain separately visible Provider observations.
Provider attribution cannot by itself populate company sales, canonical ad-linked conversion or final profit.
estimated SKU Spend remains visibly estimated and cannot independently support high-risk Recommendation, write or Settled result.
company Order, Completed, Retained and Settled sale stages remain distinct.
Completed Sales drive the early safety Guard; 30-day Retained Sales drive final sales protection.
complete affected-set company total sales must pass the frozen preservation rule.
every frozen required critical sales unit must independently pass; growth elsewhere cannot offset failure.
missing critical-unit evidence yields unresolved/inconclusive rather than pass or zero.
Advertising Contribution Profit is reconstructable from governed sales, COGS, fees, fulfillment, return loss, official Spend and applicable variable facts.
absolute Advertising Contribution Profit and Contribution Profit per official advertising RUB are calculated under exact versions.
primary efficiency success requires the sales rule plus one material profit-axis improvement and no material worsening on the other axis.
a still-negative result remains `IMPROVED_NOT_HEALTHY` or Protection-in-progress rather than healthy success.
Operational and Settled profit facts remain stage-distinct and expose evidence, window, version, Freshness, Confidence and gaps.
Provider-native conversion remains observation-only and company total sales divided by ad Clicks is rejected as canonical object conversion.
canonical ad-linked conversion requires deterministic traffic-to-sale-event linkage for the exact object/scope and sale stage.
material mapping/linkage/coverage gaps block write-grade Max CPC and expose a Provider-to-canonical attribution discrepancy.
Allowable CPA economic unit exactly matches the conversion sale stage; tests reject stage mixing and duplicate loss counting.
Max CPC is recalculable from exact stage-consistent versions and is visibly an economic ceiling, not a target.
low-sample or estimated conversion cannot produce write-grade Max CPC.
Freshness resolves by Evidence Kind, Platform/Account/Store/Semantic Profile and Decision Purpose.
source age, report completeness, accepted-fact age, publication/correction lag, version validity, coverage and Provider incident may affect Freshness.
a newly ingested old fact is not automatically Fresh; a mature cohort/effective policy is not automatically stale.
write-grade Freshness cannot be weaker than corresponding Recommendation-grade Freshness.
missing/conflicted Freshness Profile blocks only affected purposes and cannot erase an independent Fresh danger.
Optimization Watch, Task, Recommendation and Bid Write qualifications are monotonically stronger.
verified Optimization requires complete scope, coverage, sample sufficiency, sustained signal, material value and canonical profit.
immature, unsustained or immaterial signals receive Watch reason codes and no automatic Task.
a decision-determinative data defect becomes Data Repair rather than Watch.
missing/conflicted real qualification Profile blocks Verified Optimization and Bid Increase while preserving observation.
each Case deterministically resolves to Protection, Data Repair, Optimization or Watch with evidence and Policy versions.
Fresh one-sided danger activates Protection only when unknown facts cannot reverse the dangerous direction.
unknown alone cannot trigger increase, decrease, pause or success.
lane-first Canonical Priority uses reason-coded hard sub-tiers and lexicographic non-compensating factors.
Action/Outcome Regression, Quarantine, Unknown/Mismatch and Compensation responsibility enter Protection P0.
sellability/availability/critical-sales danger enters P1; proven continuing economic harm enters P2 unless stronger.
Data Repair and Optimization use their accepted independent lexicographic factor order; Watch ranking has no action authority.
AI and user-personal sorting cannot change Canonical Rank, due time or escalation.
Protection and material actionable Data Repair create/update one cause-routed Task; qualified Optimization does likewise; Watch does not.
concurrency, replay and repeated calculation cannot duplicate a Case or active cause Task.
independent causes with different owners may create explicitly linked separate Tasks.
human SLO distinguishes acknowledgement from action decision/first attributable action.
page open or free-text acknowledgement cannot satisfy the action stage.
Protection/Regression response is no weaker than Optimization; material Data Repair has a cause-owner Profile.
reassignment preserves Case age and SLO history.
outside coverage, staffed-clock handling and `OUT_OF_COVERAGE_ACTIVE_HARM` exposure remain simultaneously visible.
missing human SLO/Coverage Profile leaves Task active and blocks affected operating readiness rather than claiming on-time.
Protection/Regression targeted update meets P95 <= 5 minutes and hard <= 15 minutes; other targeted state update meets hard <= 15 minutes.
full reconciliation succeeds at least hourly and repairs a dropped targeted trigger while preserving any SLO violation.
Accepted Exception preserves the calculated lane and exact known consequence.
Exception requires exact cause/scope, evidence, consequence, Operations endorsement, Owner approval, period, review and Bundle.
valid Exception pauses only matching ordinary Action SLO, suppresses duplicate work visibly, cannot coexist with action intent, and invalidation reopens the same Case without automatic renewal.
both Ozon and Wildberries expose a complete governed Manual Shadow workflow.
Manual Packet binds exact object, affected-set, current/target configuration, evidence, Guardrails, approval route, expiry, Bundle and verification plan.
Budget, Pause/Resume or other non-selected manual actions do not create a hidden Provider API path.
Manual action cannot proceed when identity, scope, hard evidence, permission or required approval is unresolved.
verified official API Readback is accepted as strongest configuration evidence.
verified replayable official configuration export can prove exact configuration under a valid source Profile.
independent manual verification requires a distinct authorized verifier and records exact object/field/value/observed-at/evidence.
executor self-report or incomplete screenshot remains configuration-unverified.
manual verification cannot be represented as API Readback, Provider idempotency, exact application time or business success without evidence.
manual and controlled real interventions consume the same affected-set reservation and applicable aggregate exposure.
`AD_BID_CHANGE` is the only new controlled-write family in this Slice.
Budget, Campaign status, strategy/mode and Campaign/Target structure cannot be written through it.
a controlled action requires verified explicit native Bid semantics, current Bid, unit/precision/step/min/max, capability, credential, permission and Readback.
Provider-unverified paths are structurally unreachable and expose Shadow-only state.
Protection Decrease and Optimization Increase are separately gated; exact Compensation uses its own authority.
Optimization Increase requires complete write-grade Freshness, qualification, conversion/Max CPC, sales and inventory/sellability safety.
Protection Decrease requires exact one-sided danger and a valid candidate basis.
all ordinary targets come from one versioned `AD_BID_TARGET_POLICY`.
Max CPC is never automatically selected as the target.
the exact finite candidate set is deterministic for identical facts and Policy version.
Marketplace Operator may select/reject candidates but cannot free-type outside the set.
Provider valid-step normalization occurs before Preview/Approval; runtime rounding or target substitution fails acceptance.
`MAX_CPC_BOUNDED` Increase never exceeds the conservative Provider-valid ceiling.
a Protection intermediate target above the ceiling remains recovery-in-progress and not healthy.
`CAUSE_BOUND_PROTECTION_STEP` requires an exact accepted danger cause whose missing conversion cannot reverse danger.
cause-bound Preview states that Max CPC is unavailable and the target limits exposure only.
estimated conversion/Max CPC, Provider observation, similar-SKU inference and AI magnitude never generate a controlled candidate.
Materiality uses visible multi-axis non-compensating hard triggers.
initial ordinary nonzero envelope is zero and every initial nonzero action follows Maker → Operations endorsement → Owner final approval.
Maker cannot self-endorse or self-approve; unresolved Materiality fails closed.
every Preview shows exact Before/After, affected-set, critical sales, Spend, profit, inventory/sellability, versions, Bundle, route and blockers.
every executable Approval binds exact current/target, evidence snapshot, affected-set, Policy/Profile/Bundle and actors.
every executable Approval has explicit expiry at the earliest bound authority limit and is rechecked through pre-transmission/Retry.
expired, killed, quarantined, superseded or materially invalidated Approval cannot be extended/rebound/resurrected.
later Ordinary promotion requires exact all-Material mature evidence for the same Platform/Direction/Basis/scope and remains per-command Operator/Operations Maker-Checker.
fixed material triggers and Standing Policy automation cannot be downgraded or introduced by Ordinary promotion.
one approved action creates one logical Command identity and duplicate submission cannot create a second logical effect.
every eligible attempt preserves exact object, affected-set, target, Approval, Bundle and Provider identity where applicable.
a Retry cannot change target, scope or Provider idempotency identity.
verified Provider-native idempotency is used only under an evidence-backed Capability Profile and status/Readback precedes Retry.
without verified Provider idempotency, default is one Provider submission.
Timeout plus prior-value Readback never independently authorizes Retry.
explicit verified `NOT_APPLIED`, unchanged prior Bid and current authority are required for no-idempotency same-command Retry.
unresolved Command blocks replacement/parallel Command for the same native object.
Provider acceptance/HTTP success cannot become configuration success.
Readback match requires native convergence and exact approved target equality after accepted representation normalization only.
tolerance, nearest-value acceptance, runtime rounding and third-value overwrite are rejected.
generic same-object reentry is initially disabled pending separately accepted calibration.
exact Compensation remains inside original lineage/reservation and targets captured immutable prior Bid only.
Compensation requires prior matched Readback, Stop Condition/Regression, current-state ownership, current hard Gates, new Preview, Operations endorsement, Owner approval and exact Gate scope.
automatic rollback/Compensation and overwrite of later legitimate/unresolved change are impossible.
Compensation Readback is tracked separately from business Outcome.
controlled or confirmed real manual intervention reserves the complete affected-set.
overlapping affected-set action is blocked until configuration resolution, required early observation and no unresolved Regression.
non-overlapping action remains eligible only inside aggregate Exposure.
Protection/Regression receives deterministic precedence over ordinary Optimization for overlapping scope.
exact Compensation uses original reservation; known material cross-domain change blocks isolation and unexpected change confounds/rebaselines Outcome.
Gate E aggregate Envelope independently bounds active count, deduplicated Retained-Sales exposure, official Spend, cumulative absolute Bid change, unresolved writes and recovery headroom.
all aggregate axes pass independently; no cross-axis/cross-direction netting exists.
Unknown/Mismatch and governed manual interventions consume applicable aggregate capacity.
reserved recovery headroom cannot be used by ordinary action.
aggregate capacity is revalidated before transmission; Approval neither reserves capacity indefinitely nor extends while waiting.
missing/conflicted aggregate Envelope blocks new controlled transmission.
Early/Operational/Settled/late-evidence Regression creates object+affected-set+overlap quarantine and invalidates unexecuted overlap assets.
invalid shared authority version quarantines all consumers; Provider integrity defect activates exact Platform+Account/Store+Capability scope.
local business failure does not automatically stop unrelated valid non-overlapping scopes.
quarantine activation prevents every new external side effect after the authoritative instant.
PENDING and LEASED-but-unsent Commands terminate or fail transmission; already-transmitted requests continue status/Readback/reconciliation only.
unexecuted Manual Packet is revoked; uncertain manual execution enters verification/reconciliation; applied action remains fact.
deterministic hard trigger, scoped Operator Hold, Operations business Kill and Platform/Security integrity Kill enforce maximum authorized scope.
Emergency stop records reason/evidence/actor/scope/time/review owner and need not wait for Owner availability.
no actor who can activate a Hold/Kill may unilaterally reenable.
reenablement requires Root Cause closure, Unknown/Mismatch resolution, current authority evidence, Operations endorsement and Owner approval.
technical/security cause additionally requires Platform/Security closure attestation.
reenablement never restores old decision assets.
Exact Compensation may remain separately eligible during quarantine, but no Regression or Kill creates automatic reverse write.
every governed action freezes a complete Outcome Evaluation Plan before external execution.
the Plan binds Case, affected-set, lineage, action, versions, baseline, windows, critical units, coverage, sample and confounder policy.
canonical baseline selection is deterministic and cannot be chosen by AI or after result observation.
material confounder keeps early safety Guard active but blocks action-specific final verdict.
insufficient comparable history produces `OUTCOME_BASELINE_INSUFFICIENT`, not an invented benchmark.
operational association and causal incrementality remain separate.
Outcome Policy resolves by exact scoped effective version and has no hidden production default.
Policy conflict/missing state blocks final success and dependent Optimization write while preserving observation/proven-harm Task.
late data recalculation uses the action-frozen Outcome Policy.
`VERIFIED_AD_RISK_CLEARED` proves only the original advertising danger cleared.
`VERIFIED_AD_EXPOSURE_STOPPED` proves only no new dangerous exposure under complete evidence.
Protection terminal state does not close inherited inventory/listing cause or imply primary success; continuing danger remains active.

favorable Settled evidence may upgrade earlier Operational no-improvement with history preserved.
Settlement attribution unresolved cannot be converted to final result through estimated allocation.

engineering can close without real Provider side effects only when deterministic interfaces and fail-closed states are complete.
both platforms deliver full read/diagnosis/Task/Manual Shadow/Outcome business capability at engineering closure.

30-day and Settled outcomes remain continuing obligations rather than predetermined uplift prerequisites; future expansion requires exact evidence and Gate E Amendment.
every production decision resolves to one complete active scope-bound Advertising Decision Policy Bundle.
domain version publication alone cannot change production write eligibility.

late facts create explicit Daily/Weekly revision or Delta lineage without overwriting prior publication.

structured UI distinguishes confirmed, estimated, stale, blocked, Operational and Settled states and supports safe drill-through.

keyboard use, UTF-8/Russian text, UTC storage, Store-local display and safe errors are verified.

no real Provider call, hidden Budget/Status/strategy write path or browser automation exists in engineering evidence.

applied migrations remain byte-identical; clean install and protected-main upgrade pass on real PostgreSQL.
restart, replay, concurrency and reconciliation cannot duplicate facts, Cases, Tasks, Approvals, Commands, reservations, exposure, Outcomes or audit.

mutation/adversarial/fault-injection tests prove hard Gates, expiry, scope, transmission boundary, no-write, missed trigger, late data and Kill race.
